# Círculo de Bellas Artes fixtures

Captured from the official site on 2026-09-01. Structural excerpts, not
invented production events. Scripts, CSS, images and unrelated layout were
removed; titles, dates, CMS ids and the selectors used by the adapter remain.

- `listing.html`: https://www.circulobellasartes.com/eventos/ — Beaver Builder
  `fl-post-grid` of the 18 published cards, plus the archive button outside
  the grid (`pasado/`). Dates are `DD/MM/YYYY` as served.
- `detail-anderszewski.html`: https://www.circulobellasartes.com/eventos/piotr-anderszewski-piano/
- `detail-lucia.html`: https://www.circulobellasartes.com/eventos/lucia-rey-quartet/
- `detail-casals.html`: https://www.circulobellasartes.com/eventos/cuarteto-casals-2/
- `detail-guarderia.html`: https://www.circulobellasartes.com/refugio-climatico/guarderia-para-plantas/
